name: Deltoid Ligament Injury of the Ankle
tags: deltoid ligament injury of the ankle
definition: Sprain or rupture of the medial deltoid-ligament complex, often associated with ankle fracture or syndesmotic injury.

investigations.principle: Radiographs assess fracture/mortise; stress imaging or MRI is used selectively.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, cartilage, ligament or occult injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Instability from combined deltoid/syndesmotic injury may require fixation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Gulpha-Snayu injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Sprain or rupture of the medial deltoid-ligament complex, often associated with ankle fracture or syndesmotic injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, unreduced dislocation, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
